text:
maria-sales: Quick question from Acme POC — they asked for a dataroom (read-only) for their internal audit team + a signed pen-test attestation. Who can own the dataroom and who signs the pen-test letter? Need this by next Tue EOD. cc @alex-presales

alex-presales: I can spin the dataroom. Do we have the exact artifact list they want? usually provide: SOC2 Type II AOC, ISO27001 certificate excerpt, network diagram, penetration test attestation, and staging IPs for their scanner.

julian-security: We can deliver SOC2 AOC + ISO excerpt + network diag. Pen-test attestation needs legal sign-off — format can be a short letter saying "no known exploitable findings affecting in-scope systems" or a signed confirmation of last pentest date. Do they require a third-party vendor name on the letter?

maria-sales: They want the pen-test letter to reference "Redwood Inference" and the testing period (last 12 months). They also asked that the signer be someone with authority to confirm results (CISO or Head of Security) — would legal-sandra be able to sign?

legal-sandra: I can sign the attestation if julian-security + eng team approve the wording. Please share a draft. Also need to confirm there's no contractual language here (no warranty). Send draft via doc link.

alex-presales: Drafted quick template, dropping below. Also need to know if we can open the dataroom to external emails or prefer presigned link + timeboxing.

alex-presales: ```text
To whom it may concern,

This letter attests that Redwood Inference has completed a penetration test dated 2025-11-05 performed by AcmeSec LLC. Findings were remediated as of 2025-11-20. No outstanding critical vulnerabilities affecting in-scope services remain.

Signed,
Legal / Security
```

julian-security: Small edits: drop vendor name if we can't disclose, change "remediated" -> "addressed". Also confirm scope list: hosted API, dedicated backend, and staging environment IPs. I will attach network diag. Also need a 3rd-party test report redacted if they ask for details.

maria-sales: Customer emails: audit@acmecorp.com. They want dataroom access for 3 users, read-only, retain for 30 days. Timeline next Tue EOD still ok?

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-8892 — presigned dataroom S3 + user list. ETA 48h.

alex-presales: For staging IPs we can give a CIDR range and temporary creds. Warning to customer: scanning may trigger rate limits; we should whitelist their scanner IPs and schedule an ingress window. Also note dedicated POC capacity may incur extra costs — will add note to quote.

maria-sales: Thanks — can julian attach the network diagram + SOC2 AOC here? legal-sandra: I'll review draft and sign once julian confirms wording.

julian-security: Uploaded attachments to ticket (INF-8892): network-diagram-v2.pdf, soc2-aoc-2025.pdf, iso27001-excerpt.pdf. Pen-test report is vendor-confidential; we will provide an attestation letter only.

legal-sandra: Reviewed draft, removed warranty clause, signing on behalf of Redwood — will sign after alex updates template to the final wording with "addressed" change and adds signatory block: Name, Title, Date.

maria-sales: Sending final draft to customer now. @ops-bot can you provision read-only links for audit@acmecorp.com x3 and set 30d expiry?

ops-bot: Presigned links created and emailed to audit@acmecorp.com. Links expire 30 days. Ticket INF-8892 updated with logs.

maria-sales: Great — closing. Thanks everyone :tada:
